verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a cloud browser-automation service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a self-hosted deployment of the core product. The `"self"` P2P tunnel only routes traffic through the user's IP, and the GitHub repo is a client SDK/CLI; both are adjacent features, not self-hosting. Community comments indicate the product runs only as a third-party hosted service, with users explicitly asking for it to be made self-hostable.
